violation_type.title: Notification of Changing Address or Location (26 TAC §744.301(1))
violation_type.short_title: Notification of Changing Address or Location
violation_type.typical_finding: The change of location of permitted space for the children was not notified to CCR.

finding_variants.text: The change of location of permitted space for the children was not notified to CCR.

The change of location of permitted space for the children was not notified to CCR. For the follow up inspection nothing was done to show what back up space will be used by the after school program and formal notification to CCR was not given to show that the program will only be allowed in permitted areas only.
The operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation regarding the temporary relocation since January 2025.
